artifacts.summary: Five sequential phases (7 h): re-verify every anchor and write the spec's Section 0; author Sections A-D (three obligations and the lift); draft Section H's six statement-shaped records T1-T6 with typed edges and file_scope; file them via state-write.sh in Kahn order and record the numbers; hand-edit ROADMAP Stage 1 and run the full gate. No file outside specs/** is touched.

memory_candidates.content: A lean4-typed task whose deliverable is a specification plus filed task records (it proves nothing and names no Lean identifier under Goals) must OMIT the plan's Lean Challenge Statements section entirely rather than include it empty: lean-challenge-snapshot.sh exits 71 on a present-but-empty section and also exits 71 under its git-baseline fallback when Goals carries no identifiers, so --compare is inapplicable to such a task and should be stated so in the plan's Decisions. plan-format.md's 'present only when task_type is lean4' conditional does not state this zero-goals case.
